name: mirage
text: Understood: an audit of every API for waste. Order: (1) PinnWire/pinnapi, already fixed in code and landing once the full test passes; (2) then each other metered API (ParlayAPI, PropLine, The Odds API, SGO, OddsPapi, Unabated, Kalshi, SX, BoltOdds): what it is asked for, what it costs, and whether a fresher or already-paid feed gives the same data. I'll write the findings to research/ and fix what is clearly waste.
